content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing the same issue, even after changing the IP, subnet mask, and gateway on both my computer and the [product_name]. Nothing has worked so far, so I'm reaching out for your support. Here are my settings: [product_name] has IP 192.168.126.51, subnet mask 255.255.252.0, gateway 192.168.124.1. My PC has IP 192.168.126.49, subnet mask 255.255.252.0, gateway 192.168.124.1. Thank you in advance for any help.

Hello [user_name], Where did these settings for the [product_name] and the PC come from? Did you configure them yourself? Based on my understanding, with IP 192.168.126.xxx, the subnet mask should be 255.255.255.0. Why is the subnet 192.168.126.xxx while the gateway is set to 192.168.124.1?

Hi, I am not an expert in subnets, but your configuration looks reasonable to me. A subnet of 255.255.252.0 should cover IPs from 192.168.124.1 up to 192.168.127.254. However, I've faced similar problems connecting to a [product_name] when the network connection was misconfigured. For example, I once tried to connect using a wired connection while the [product_name] software was set to use the wireless adapter. From your screenshot, it seems you’re using an Intel Ethernet (likely wired). Is your computer connected via cable or Wi-Fi?
The [product_name] is a class 3 controller. Its subnet mask should be 255.255.255.0. More details about network classes can be found here: [url]

Additionally, the default settings at delivery for [product_name] devices are: [product_name] TDE: IP address 192.168.0.2, subnet mask 255.255.255.0 [product_name] version_no: IP address 192.168.0.3, subnet mask 255.255.255.0

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble connecting a PC and a [product_name] because they're unsure of the correct IP and subnet mask settings. There is confusion around which network parameters to use, causing inconsistent setups and failures in communication. The distinction between default and customized network settings further complicates the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple process for connecting their PC to a [product_name] via ethernet, believing that matching network parameters should allow for seamless communication without these setup challenges.
